lines: I understood in my head and then lamented
I laughed at the way it rolled away
I don’t get loneliness or love
Human form was thrown out
A proof of existence full of words I can’t hold
I can’t leave this tiny theater
When I realized it, I just wanted to run away
We all were acting
We head toward the end credits
Come on, everyone is desperately playing their role; there are no onlookers
There is no “I”
It isn’t anywhere
I’ve always been unable to become anything
Now we’re devouring each other
Overtime, we surrender
May Day, a faint affection
A stream of love and hate spilling out
We’re hoping for some dramatic twist somewhere
You too, yes, yes, gasp
The command is right there
Even the head‑shot, the restless yearning
Pierce that heart, now
Pull the unseen thread, the mastermind appears
What reflects in those eyes
It would shatter if touched
I fell silent as it crumbled
We were all innocent
Somehow I became a monster
If I don’t accept all of it, I can’t move forward
“Well, it’s probably impossible for you”
“That’s why it’s probably impossible for you”
Somehow I ended up on the sidelines
I only threw idle chatter
Everyone desperately protects themselves, waiting for a saving hand
I don’t want to think about it
I want to stay foolish
I’ve always been unable to become anything
So now I stand on the front line
That flag flutters high
In defeat, I rely on my partner
Even words aren’t needed
A dramatic turn will surely heat up the scene
You too, yes, yes, gasp
We vow to meet again
I have only one chance
I’ll stake my fleeting moment
Like a climax, my hands sweat
It rang out softly
There is no hidden truth anywhere
Those who laughed have no place
I recall, but there’s no feeling
The tears I shed have no reason
Kindness feels without temperature
The outstretched hand is met only with doubt
A hole opened and love dripped away
You peered at the collapsing me
In front of the one who almost gave up, you
Always appear as if mocking
How do I look to you
Steady your breath, now
Now, I’ve always been unable to become anything
Now we’re devouring each other
Overtime, we surrender
May Day, a faint affection
A stream of love and hate spilling out
We’re hoping for some dramatic twist somewhere
You too, yes, yes, gasp
The command is right there
Even the head‑shot, the restless yearning
Pierce that heart, now
Pull the unseen thread, the mastermind appears
“What reflects in those eyes”
